TenantSecurityPolicyChangeLog.name: TenantSecurityPolicyChangeLog
TenantSecurityPolicyChangeLog.description: Tracks changes to Security Center policy fields. Each record represents a single field change on a policy.

Field.description: The name of the field that was changed.

Name.description: The unique identifier for the change log record.

NewValue.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

OldValue.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

PolicyIdentifier.description: The ID of this policy. Contains a unique virtual key from child to parent.
